subject.title: fix(release): stabilize beta validation and completion

question: Should this release-gate repair require a controlled live helper transcript before it is included in the beta-validation path?
rationale: The remaining question is operational proof for a release workflow that may require maintainer-controlled GitHub and release access; unit tests alone cannot safely demonstrate its completed-run and cleanup path.

options.title: Capture controlled completion proof
options.body: Run the helper against a safe pinned validation workflow and attach redacted terminal or workflow evidence showing completion, evidence verification, and cleanup.

options.title: Accept an explicit proof override
options.body: A release owner may accept the focused test evidence instead when a controlled live run would create unacceptable release-operation cost or risk.

recommendation.title: Capture controlled completion proof
recommendation.body: Run the helper against a safe pinned validation workflow and attach redacted terminal or workflow evidence showing completion, evidence verification, and cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and are assigned to the focused release-validation forward-port, making them the best available routing contact from the supplied history.
